summary: CalEthos, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a $15M loan (increased to $16M via refinancing) from SFO IDF LLC, an entity owned by a trust for family members of director Sean Fontenot. The note bears 8% interest, matures Dec 31, 2028, and includes a warrant for 5M shares (increased by 1M) at $0.50/share. Proceeds fund a proposed joint venture, approvals, a CD for a letter of credit, and general corporate purposes. This is a related-party debt financing, not a special situation. No terms on price per share, premium, or close date exist; the filing notes a material definitive agreement and unregistered securities issuance.
